# Hank Chen — Taiwan Traditional Chinese Localization

> Hank Chen is a Taiwan-based localizer who converts English and Simplified Chinese content into Traditional Chinese as actually used in Taiwan — not character conversion, but Taiwan wording, tone, and usage. Services: website and app localization, marketing copy, bilingual subtitles (SRT), and Simplified-to-Taiwan review. First page free trial.

## Tools
- [Taiwan Wording Checker (free)](https://z2idugagr.github.io/checker/): Free online checker that flags 42 common Mainland-China wording and Simplified-conversion pitfalls and gives the Taiwan-correct term.

## Services
- [English services, rates and FAQ](https://z2idugagr.github.io/en/): English to Taiwan Traditional Chinese localization for brands, SaaS, and indie games.
- [Simplified Chinese to Taiwan review](https://z2idugagr.github.io/simplified-to-taiwan-review/): Review service that rewrites Simplified-converted text into natural Taiwan usage.
- [Quote calculator](https://z2idugagr.github.io/quote/): Instant estimate and free first-page trial request.
- [Retainer review](https://z2idugagr.github.io/retainer/): Monthly Simplified-to-Taiwan review retainer.

## Resources
- [Free Taiwan wording cheat sheet](https://z2idugagr.github.io/free/): Free sample of the Taiwan terminology checklist; the full version is on Gumroad.
- [Partner tools](https://z2idugagr.github.io/tools/): Tools and partner resources for localization work.
- [Podcast: Taiwan Wording Clinic](https://z2idugagr.github.io/podcast/feed.xml): Short episodes dissecting one Taiwan wording pitfall at a time (Traditional Chinese).
